prompt: Name one of the first ten presidents of the United States.
label: Final Dig
source: The White House list of presidents: https://www.whitehouse.gov/about-the-white-house/presidents/
valueLogic: Washington and Jefferson are free. Adams, Madison and Jackson follow. Monroe and John Quincy Adams sit in the middle. Van Buren, Tyler and William Henry Harrison are the tail - three presidents most people cannot place in the first ten at all.
note: Bare 'Adams' is ambiguous between the two answers and asks the player to be more specific. Bare 'Harrison' hits a non-busting distractor asking which one, so it never silently resolves to William Henry.

answers.name: George Washington
answers.fact: The first, and the only president elected unanimously by the Electoral College.

answers.name: Thomas Jefferson
answers.fact: Third. Wrote the Declaration and doubled the size of the country with the Louisiana Purchase.

answers.name: John Adams
answers.fact: Second, and the first to live in the White House - for the last four months of his term.

answers.name: James Madison
answers.fact: Fourth. Known as the father of the Constitution, and the smallest president at 5 foot 4.

answers.name: Andrew Jackson
answers.fact: Seventh, and the first from neither Virginia nor Massachusetts.

answers.name: James Monroe
answers.fact: Fifth. His Monroe Doctrine shaped American foreign policy for a century.

answers.name: John Quincy Adams
answers.fact: Sixth. Lost the popular vote and won in the House, then served in Congress for 17 years after.

answers.name: Martin Van Buren
answers.fact: Eighth, and the first president born a US citizen rather than a British subject.

answers.name: John Tyler
answers.fact: Tenth. The first vice president to succeed on a death, and he fathered 15 children.

answers.name: William Henry Harrison
answers.fact: Ninth. Served 31 days, the shortest presidency, after the longest inaugural address.

distractors.name: Harrison
distractors.note: Two presidents were named Harrison - William Henry, the ninth, and Benjamin, the 23rd. Say which.

distractors.name: Benjamin Harrison
distractors.note: The 23rd president, and William Henry Harrison's grandson.

distractors.name: James K. Polk
distractors.note: Eleventh - one place outside the ten.
